newsitem.title: CHINA: China names Jiang Enzhu to head HK Xinhua office.
newsitem.headline: China names Jiang Enzhu to head HK Xinhua office.

text.p: China announced on Friday the appointment of Jiang Enzhu to head the Hong Kong branch of its Xinhua news agency, which until the July 1 handover acted as Beijing's de facto representative in the territory.
Jiang, a former ambassador to Britain, had been appointed recently to his new post by the State Council, or cabinet, the Xinhua news agency said.

Hong Kong newspapers had earlier speculated that Jiang, who now gives up his post in London, would become head of the Foreign Ministry's office in Hong Kong. That job went to his predecessor in London, Ma Yuzhen.
Since China took back Hong Kong from Britain on July 1, Beijing has signalled that it was downgrading the role of its Xinhua news agency branch.

However, the agency was expected to continue to serve as a political liaison post for Beijing in its new special administrative region as well as carrying out its core function as a news agency, analysts said.
